name: tessera
description: React tiling layout: a Workspace renders a layout config as tiles with modules, fixed or resizable dividers
author: Jose Matas

scripts.build: npm run type-check && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp src/styles.css dist/styles.css
scripts.format:branch: f() { FILES=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR $(git merge-base HEAD ${BASE_BRANCH:-main})); TSX_FILES=$(echo "$FILES" | grep -E '\.(ts|tsx)$'); if [ -n "$TSX_FILES" ]; then eslint $TSX_FILES --fix; fi; if [ -n "$FILES" ]; then prettier $FILES --write --ignore-unknown; fi; }; f
scripts.format:branch:check: f() { FILES=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR $(git merge-base HEAD ${BASE_BRANCH:-main})); TSX_FILES=$(echo "$FILES" | grep -E '\.(ts|tsx)$'); if [ -n "$TSX_FILES" ]; then eslint $TSX_FILES; fi && if [ -n "$FILES" ]; then prettier $FILES --check --ignore-unknown; fi; }; f
